title: The Gold Swallowing Mouse Tribe
summary: Xiao Yan drives off the Ground Spirit Gate men, and his Heavenly Flame suppresses Wang Chen's darkness-type Corpse Eroding Hand, so Wang Chen withdraws and promises to meet him at the Heaven Mountain Stage. Nalan Yanran tells Xiao Yan she now trains alone, and the two travel on together with her Psychic White Fox. At the maze, Wang Chen tells a band of Dou Huangs about the fox, and when they attack, Xiao Yan kills them all with the Flame Splitting Tsunami. Jin Gu, a Dou Zong of the Gold Swallowing Mouse Tribe, lets him pass after Xiao Yan gives him Qi Mending Pills. With the fox leading, the pair cross the maze and reach the Heaven Mountain Stage just in time. The tribe's leader Jin Shi sets the first test: climb to the summit within an hour under the mice's sonic waves. Hu Ya and Hu Cheng of the Bone Transforming Gate try first and fail.
events: Xiao Yan drives off the Ground Spirit Gate men.
Wang Chen withdraws after Xiao Yan's Heavenly Flame beats his Corpse Eroding Hand.
Nalan Yanran explains the Psychic White Fox and the Gold Swallowing Mouse Tribe, and the two travel together.
Wang Chen sets a group of Dou Huangs on them; Xiao Yan kills them.
Jin Gu of the Gold Swallowing Mouse Tribe lets Xiao Yan through for some pills.
Xiao Yan and Nalan Yanran cross the maze with the fox and reach the Heaven Mountain Stage.
Jin Shi announces the sonic-wave climbing test.
Hu Ya and Hu Cheng of the Bone Transforming Gate fail the test.
cultivation: Wang Chen is said to be at the peak of Dou Huang. Jin Gu is a Dou Zong. The leader of the Gold Swallowing Mouse Tribe is as strong as a Six-Star Dou Zong.
